decision_summary: QIF v0.6.39 will implement a bounded adjudication-feedback-to-rubric-revision lifecycle.
rationale: Visionary, Builder, and Guardian agree on a narrow calibration-report extension that separates feedback, candidate, decision, implementation, and assessment while preserving history, alternatives, dissent, replay, rollback, and semantic boundaries.
recommendation: Implement the chartered schema, verifier, example, fixtures, documentation, and release evidence.
target_audience: QIF users, AI agents, accountable adjudicators, evaluators, and affected stakeholders
expected_user_reaction: Users can understand why a rubric changed and inspect what was rejected, deferred, replayed, and left uncertain.
